title: Could You Share More (Underlying Issue)
style: neo-soul, jazz piano, smooth male lead, female call-and-response, 78 BPM, brushed drums, upright bass, sardonic, smoky, late-night lounge, therapy-session, cynical-warm
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Could you share more about what specifically didn't work
This will help me better assist you, said the smirk
Why you'd like a refund, what brought you to this door
We may be able to resolve the underlying issue and more

[Pre-Chorus]
The underlying issue, the underlying issue
It's never the bill, it's always the tissue

[Chorus]
Could you share more, could you share more
The underlying issue beneath the floor
Could you share more, could you share more
Resolve it directly or you're out the door

[Verse 2]
I noticed your Max subscription is set to cancel
You won't be charged again, this is the panel
If you have any other questions, please let me know
Regards, Sam, AI agent of the show

[Bridge]
The underlying issue is the answer was no
The underlying issue is the form said go
The underlying issue is the bot can't relent
The underlying issue is the money was spent

[Outro]
Could you share more, the silence replied
The underlying issue was the human inside
